charts.title: Weekly review volume steps up 2.8× at the July sampling shift: a property of the feed, not of demand
All three failure signals step down at the July shift, together with review length (60 → 42 words)
PhonePe and Paytm carry the July step (-22.2 and -13.8 pp in 1–2★ share); Zomato and Swiggy move least (-0.4 and -4.3 pp)
Each app keeps its own issue mix week after week: 1 of 523 app-issue-weeks spike above 3 SE, 2 of 45 series trend after July
SES forecasts the 1–2★ share with 1.2–7.0 pp error; the all-history mean, blind to the July step, is worst in 18 of 24 series
Pooled forecast: about 68% of reviews rated 1–2★ over the next 4 weeks (80% interval 61–74% by week 4)
% rated 1–2★, 4-week forecast by app: from 38% (PhonePe) to 93% (Swiggy)
Mean star rating, 4-week forecast by app: from 1.25★ (Swiggy) to 3.23★ (PhonePe)
